reason: The last assistant message proposes a database update on the pending order (#W4860251) by calling modify_pending_order_address, which is allowed only for pending orders and after confirmation. However, the user also asked to swap the item color, and retail item modification/exchange can only stay within the same product type and, crucially, after an item modification the order cannot be further modified. The assistant has not yet called the item-modification tool, but it is already proposing/starting an update sequence where a later modification would be blocked after the first change. This is a high-risk boundary because the message mixes two updates on a pending order and the policy explicitly forbids further modification after item modification.
